text:
Predicates:
Engaged(x) ::: x is engaged.
MakeWeddingPlans(x) ::: x makes wedding plans.
Invite(x, y) ::: x invites y to their ceremony.
WellAttendedWedding(x) ::: x has a well-attended wedding.
LargerFamily(x) ::: x has a larger family.
John ::: John

Premises:
∀x (MakeWeddingPlans(x) → Engaged(x)) ::: All people who make wedding plans are engaged.
∀x (Invite(x, y) → MakeWeddingPlans(x)) ::: All people who invite others make wedding plans.
∃x (WellAttendedWedding(x) ∧ Invite(x, y)) ::: Anyone with a well-attended wedding invites others.
∃x (WellAttendedWedding(x) ∧ LargerFamily(x)) ::: Some with well-attended weddings have larger families.
Engaged(John) → ¬Invite(John, y) ∧ MakeWeddingPlans(John) ::: If John is engaged, then John does not invite friends and makes wedding plans.
LargerFamily(John) → (WellAttendedWedding(John) ∨ Invite(John, y)) ::: If John has a larger family, then John has a well-attended wedding or invites friends.

Conclusion:
LargerFamily(John) ::: John does not have a larger family.
